name: 2g MKX Disposable *LIMITED EDITION* Detroit Sports Edition - Tigers Breath - Indica
description:
Introducing the MKX 2g Disposables: Detroit Sports Editions — three exclusive, team-inspired strains crafted for the fans who rep the city loud. Each 2-gram disposable is engineered for smooth airflow, optimized power, and consistent performance; plus our NEW mechanical button with tactile feedback – equipped with a pre-heat function & battery life indication. 
 
Formulated with premium distillate and precise terpene blends, these limited releases are available in Sativa, Hybrid, and Indica varieties, each bringing bold, standout flavor profiles unique to the drop.

Tigers Breath — Indica
Spicy, earthy, prickly pear, and gas — deep, heavy, and ideal for slowing things down after a long nine innings. 

Instructions: 

Press 1X—Check Battery Life 

Press 2X—Preheat Mode 

Press 5X—Turn On/Off 

Inhale Activated 

Battery Life: 

1 Light: -25% 

2 Lights: 25-50% 

3 Lights: 50-70% 

4 Lights: 70-100%
